text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be because of all those dinners lately...?
...No, what I need to focus on right now is—!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for springing this on you out of nowhere. But I really
need to find a solution before our next day off.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Since you pay such close attention to maintaining your figure
as a locodol, I thought you might know some good tricks.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Let's see... I do know a diet dance that's trending among local idols, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you're aiming to do all that by your next day off,
it's going to be pretty grueling, you know?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind. No matter what it takes,
I want to tone up by that day."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because on that day...
I promised to go on a date with Vivlos and the others!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
As the older sister, I can't look pathetic out there!
—Never ever!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, what intense energy...!
I feel like I'm getting fired up too...!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, got it! I won't go easy on you, so be prepared!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
One-two, one-two!
Come on, Verxina, you're falling behind!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
O-One-two! One-two...!
—...Big sis will do her best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As a result of giving her all to a hardcore dance,
Verxina successfully
managed to diet."
